coverage_note: I reviewed every assigned item and page, the direct dependency Statement/Definition sections used in their claims, the proof-contract summaries, the two required pages, the cited adaptive-algorithm comparisons, and the primary source locations for the update and regret conventions. I did not re-audit every published dependency proof or every deeper transitive foundational proof. The locally authored Adam/AMSGrad variants were compared with [Reddi, Kale, and Kumar, On the Convergence of Adam and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1904.09237), [Kingma and Ba, Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1412.6980), [Bottou, Curtis, and Nocedal, Optimization Methods for Large-Scale Machine Learning](https://leon.bottou.org/publications/pdf/tr-optml-2016.pdf), and [Hazan, Introduction to Online Convex Optimization, §5.6.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1909.05207). No in-flight dependency finding or assigned mathematical defect was found.
